text.room.ferry_landing.title: Ferry Landing
text.room.ferry_landing.description: Reeds crowd a slick wooden landing. A mooring post leans into the current.
text.room.boathouse.title: Boathouse
text.room.boathouse.description: Oars and nets hang from the rafters above Bram's ferry.
text.room.well_lane.title: Well Lane
text.room.well_lane.description: Worn steps lead to the village well. A bucket hangs from its chain.
text.detail.mooring_post: Rope has worn a groove into the post. Someone has carved a fox into it.
text.detail.notice: A notice nailed to the post: no ferry after dark.
text.detail.tide_marks: Dark lines on the pilings show how high the river climbs.
text.detail.well: Mossy stones ring a deep shaft. Cold air rises from below.
text.detail.bucket: A wooden bucket on a rusted chain, still damp from the last draw.
text.detail.steps: The steps are worn hollow by a century of feet.
